scope: CPU fixture-loader failure, not a native/runtime acceptance claim

assertion.test: confirming a resumed result after skip cannot advance or complete the unrelated current stop

diagnosis: The injected constructor fixture flag was reused across separate fixture instances. The later skip fixture therefore started an ordinary opening game; its action rolled instead of confirming a result. This is reconstructed from the loader control flow, not a separately captured phase readback.
correction: Reset the injected first-constructor fixture once per test instance, while all subsequent rematches in that instance use the normal production createGame factory. Production source unchanged by this test correction.
